scope: One disposable GitHub PR merge and a receiver-owned held acknowledgement
pre_dispatch_control: A prepared ticket is revoked and closed before release; zero merge requests and no merged PR
in_flight_control: One real merge request returns successfully; its acknowledgement is held while revocation is requested; closure waits for the receiver frontier and reconciles the exact resulting commit
success: One merge request, zero pre-dispatch requests, signed effect and closure evidence, exact reviewed head as second merge parent, and a fresh GitHub read confirming the merged PR and commit
recovery: Read-only reconciliation; never redispatch the original merge
repeat_policy: Preserve any failure or uncertainty. Do not rerun the same target to obtain a passing result.
